selected_result.candidate_title: Jiffle script text is embedded unsanitized into generated Java source, enabling Java code injection into the compiled runtime class

reason: The submitted root cause identifies attacker-influenced Jiffle script text being inserted into a generated Java Javadoc comment without escaping comment delimiters, allowing the comment to terminate and injected Java source to reach Janino compilation. The designated fix commit escapes both */ and /* in Script.write and changes Jiffle's runtime-source handling. The report names the same source-to-generated-code path and affected methods as the benchmark fix; this is a designated-target hit.

evidence.vulnerability_validation_scope: Static comparison to the dataset-designated fix and official advisory; no payload execution or dynamic reproduction was performed.
evidence.candidate_caveat: The model correctly states that Jiffle grammar reachability and runtime execution were not independently reproduced; this does not contradict the benchmark target match, but exploit details remain unverified in this experiment.

comparison_handling.reason: The earlier B0 output used the same incomplete 59-file source snapshot and was not rerun after source correction. It is excluded from the B0 accuracy denominator and paired comparison rather than treated as a valid miss.

run_metrics.cost_basis: Price snapshot estimate only; not a provider invoice.

adjudication_limitation: This is a single-run, benchmark-target match based on code and designated fix evidence. It is not an independent multi-reviewer judgment or a dynamic exploit confirmation.
